notes.title: Rick Henderson spin-off is being made!
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

once again i'd like to thank everyone for supporting Rick Henderson, it means the world to me. 

I want to reward everyone that had faith in me and bought the game, so i'm working on a small spin-off that will be something like BitBlaster XL meets Rick Henderson, a top down bite-sized game that will be [b]free[/b] for all Rick Henderson owners.

Here's the video of the development version (it's still rough around the edges, some sprites need changing and a lot of juice needs to be added, but it's all going quite quickly). Core loop is there, adding some more pickups and special abilities. Like in Rick Henderson, goal is to last as long as possible in the progressively harder surroundings. Touching the screen edges is insta-death :)

[previewyoutube=IT2ACQQemVU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you like it, it will be available soon!

Stay well :)

notes.title: Final Early Access Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

sorry for the lack of updates, i had COVID and it took me a while to get back on track. I've been really busy preparing everything for the full release, lots of new waves, better tutorial, UI, overall better performance and stability, localization to German, Japanese, Spanish, Chinese and French.

I've been working on the game for more than five years and time has come to wrap things up. There's a lot more that i'd like to add to the game, but at one point i have to release it. At the moment, i think it provides a lot of fun, especially for the price tag. If the game goes well in terms of sales i will be working on additional content which can be seen on the Roadmap in the Discussions part of the Steam page.

I would like to thank to all the players participating in the early access, you helped made a better game, i hope all of you will enjoy it, both rookies and veterans in the genre.

As always, if you have any bug reports, be sure to report them.

New version is now online, be sure to update it and i hope you will enjoy it. See you on full release.

notes.title: New perks and new weapon online
notes.content:
[h1]Perks[/h1]

Short Fuse - Launch mini mines when hit. 10 mini mines are launched in random direction from the player ship when hit. Pretty cool, the mini mines are the same ones from the Bull Hammer weapon.
Razor Rider - Increases Graze radius (default is 0.15, perk increases it to 0.20) - NOT stackable. Makes is quite easy to graze with that kind of radius.
Matrix Stabilizer - Increases Hologram duration by 2 seconds (default is 4) - stackable, so hologram can last a pretty long time.
Photon Stabilizer - Increases Microwarp distance by 5 (default is 10 units) - stackable. Muchos jumpos.
Provisions - Increases Artillery Strike Missile number by 5 (default is 20) - stackable for maximum punch.

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

Randomizer - Energy weapon that shoots small round bullets that randomly move around the screen, but never backwards. Damage per bullet is not bad (30 per bullet) and the firing rate is good so you can spam the screen with it while waiting for the wave to appear. However, you can't really target with it so it's kind of a gimmick weapon to have fun.

notes.title: Perks balancing
notes.content:
Since i want a stronger feeling of importance of perk selection so you can actually make a categorized build, i improved some of the perks.

[b]Shield Overload[/b] now adds +100 damage to shield damage instead of 50 (default is 75 for Ben, 100 for Rick, 125 for Thoraxx)

[b]Shield Battery [/b]now adds +2 seconds to shield duration instead of +1 second (default is 0.75 seconds for Ben, 1 second for Rick, 1,25 seconds for Thoraxx)

[b]Speed Freak [/b]now adds +0.2 speed to ship (default speeds are 1.1 for Ben, 1.0 for Rick, 0.9 for Thoraxx)

I believe that previous values were too small to make a difference and I hope these changes will improve the importance of perk selection and enable some cool ship builds in longer games like boosting the shield to last 10 seconds, make the ship go very VERY fast or make the shield damage extremely devastating.

Also, horizontal speed of ranks is lowered from a maximum of 1.5 to 1 so the player can catch up, sometimes they just move to fast and it feels unfair.

notes.title: Quick Draw Perk
notes.content: I believe some of you were annoyed with the speed the weapons change and would like perks to be something more substantial to the ships upgrades. I added Quick Draw perk under Support perks which enables you to switch your weapons in half the time, which is pretty much instantaneously.

notes.title: Gameplay tweaks and bug fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Tweaks[/h1]

[list]
[*] Provoker bullet speed lowered from 1.25 to 1.00
[*] Bloodhound missile damage raised from 13 to 25
[*] Riftminers boss mk3 now shoots 50% less asteroids in asteroid barrage pattern
[*] Updated the progression scale of the levels for faster leveling and going through loops. A small explanation how things work. Every enemy kill gets you (invisible to player) experience points which differ from enemy to enemy. Once you hit the threshold, boss spawns. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/02ql2yC.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r15HmPZ.png[/img]

With the old, linear system, later levels tend to last too long and there is no cap. With the new system, levels last shorter so the whole thing is more dynamic, plus the progression is capped after level 15.

Warp malfunctions are tied to level length (each warp malfunction lasts half of XP needed for completing the next level) so they are shorter now too.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

Fixed bloom effect which got broken after the update to new Unity version
Fixed images and weapons names appearing wrong
Fixed some issues with warp malfunction (also lasts shorter)
Fixed dark pact not displaying health properly
Fixed resolution issues, game now supports only 16:9 aspect ratio, up to 1920x1080. Due to technical difficulties i'm unable to support different aspect rations and UHD resolutions at the moment
[/list]

[h1]
Tutorial and controls rebinding are still in the works, slowly getting there. 
Also started laying foundations for translations.[/h1]

As usual per every update, resolution and other settings will probably be reset so you have to adjust them again.
